MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 12, 2024
  6201 APPIAN WAY
  LONG BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

Jo Murray, Chair  Gordana Kajer, Commissioner
Bruce Mac Rae, Vice Chair  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
Avis Atkins McPhail, Commissioner  Theresa Marino, Commissioner
Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner  Sabrina Zavala, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  TAMALYN.SAYRE@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54654  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, August 8, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54840  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Marina Green parking lot.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54658  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Bluff Park Bluffs.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-54657  Recommendation to support the proposed FY25 Slip Fee Increase in accordance
  with the City Council Action of May 5, 2015, related to the issuance of the Marina
  Revenue Bonds, Series 2015.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-54739  Recommendation to discuss LBMC 16.08.650 (B) Marine Stadium West.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-54655  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  24-54656  Recommendation to receive and file the Committee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 12, 2024
  6201 APPIAN WAY
  LONG BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

8.  24-54660  Recommendation to continue the discussion on the Marine Advisory Commission’s
  regular meeting time and date; BYLAWS, ARTICLE Vl Meetings Section 1.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau at (562) 570-3215 by noon the
day prior to the meeting.
